name: Panda Dynasty
source:
Panda Dynasty is a semi-linear furry visual novel that mixes comedy, romance and thriller. You will embody a panda who can talk with spirits and see your life upside down when you meet Torito, an ex cop who searches revenge against a strange cult, and Andrew, a clumsy tiger who needs help to find his mother. Meanwhile, you’ll have to deal with the disappearance of your ghost father and all the mystery that surrounds his death.

The main theme is love and family, and about finding a safe place and breaking the circle of family pain.

[From [url=https://ordinarysstar.itch.io/pandadynasty]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《熊猫王朝》是一部融合了喜剧、浪漫和惊悚的半线性毛茸茸视觉小说。当你遇到托里托（一名前警察，正在向奇怪的邪教组织复仇）和安德鲁（一只笨拙的老虎，需要帮助才能找到他的母亲）时，你将化身为一只可以与灵魂交谈的熊猫，并看到你的生活发生了翻天覆地的变化。与此同时，你必须处理你幽灵父亲的失踪以及围绕他死亡的所有谜团。

主题是爱和家庭，以及寻找安全的地方并打破家庭痛苦的循环。

[来自[url=https://ordinarysstar.itch.io/pandadynasty]Itch.io[/url]]
